units.source_text: 来到西殿，但见格子窗还不曾关，大概紫姬通宵凝望，不曾就寝。

en.t: When he came to the western wing, he saw that the lattice shutters had not yet been closed; Lady Murasaki must have gazed out all night without going to bed.

units.source_text: 众青年侍女及女童都在各处廊下假寐，看见公子来了，大家起来迎接。

en.t: The young ladies in waiting and girl attendants had been dozing here and there under the corridors, and when they saw the prince arrive, they all rose to greet him.

units.source_text: 她们都作值宿打扮，憧憧来往。

en.t: They were all dressed for night duty, moving busily back and forth like shifting shadows.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，又不免伤心，他想：“今后再经若干年月，这些人不耐寂寞，势必纷纷散去。”

en.t: Seeing this, Prince Genji could not help feeling sad again, and thought, "After some years pass, these people will surely be unable to bear the loneliness and will scatter one by one."

units.source_text: 平日向不在意之事，现在都触目惊心。

en.t: Things he had never paid attention to before now startled and pained him whenever they met his eyes.

units.source_text: 他对紫姬说：“昨夜只因有这些事，直到破晓才能回家。

en.t: He said to Lady Murasaki, "Because of all these matters last night, I could not return home until daybreak.

units.source_text: 想你不会疑心我胡行乱为吧。

en.t: I hope you do not suspect me of having behaved recklessly or improperly.

units.source_text: 至少在我还居住于京都的期间，是舍不得离开你的。

en.t: At least while I am still living in the capital, I cannot bear to leave your side.

units.source_text: 但是现在即将远行，牵怀之事，自然甚多，岂能闭门不出？

en.t: But now that I am about to travel far away, there are naturally many things weighing on my heart; how could I shut myself indoors and never go out?

units.source_text: 在这无常的世间，被人视为薄情而唾弃，也毕竟是痛心的。”

en.t: In this impermanent world, to be regarded as heartless and cast aside by others is, after all, a painful thing."

units.source_text: 紫姬只回答道：“除了此次之事以外，世间哪有更大的飞来横祸呢？”

en.t: Lady Murasaki only replied, "Apart from this, what greater sudden calamity could there be in the world?"

units.source_text: 她那伤心苦思之状，异于他人，自是理之当然。

en.t: That her grief and anxious brooding were unlike anyone else's was only natural.

units.source_text: 因为父亲兵部卿亲王一向疏远，她从小依附源氏。

en.t: Because her father, Prince Hyobukyo, had always kept his distance, she had depended on Genji since childhood.

units.source_text: 何况父亲近来惧怕权势，对公子音问久疏，此次亦绝不前来慰问。

en.t: Moreover, her father had lately feared those in power and had long neglected all contact with the prince; even now he would not come to offer comfort.

units.source_text: 旁人见此情形，定然讪笑，紫姬深以为耻。

en.t: If others saw this situation, they would surely sneer at it, and Lady Murasaki felt deeply ashamed.

units.source_text: 她想：当时不教父亲知道她的下落，倒反而干净。

en.t: She thought that not letting her father know her whereabouts at the time had, in fact, been the cleaner course.
